content.text:
Finding submitted.

**Summary:** Section 14.1 (Miscellaneous) is the only assignment provision; Sections 11.1–11.3 contain no change-of-control termination or re-pricing right, so the walk-away risk is absent. The clause is mutual and includes a merger/acquisition/substantially-all-assets successor carve-out, but it fails the fallback because consent for other assignments (and for a competitor successor) is unqualified and there is no notice mechanic for successor assignments. I proposed a single surgical insertion adding the "not unreasonably withheld" standard and written notice, leaving all other wording — including the direct-competitor consent proviso and the null-and-void mechanic — verbatim.
